info.title: Tenant API
info.description: One store's API, served on the store's own domain ({slug}.tenant-ecommerce-api.test). Staff routes are under /admin and use a staff bearer token from `POST /admin/auth/login`; storefront routes accept an optional customer token, and guests send `X-Guest-Token`.
